Hence, (697, 13, 866) is the correct answer.

questions.question: Select the option that is related to the fourth number in the same way as the first number is related to the second number and the fifth number is related to the sixth number. 12 : 136 : : ? : 188 : : 24 : 568
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that is related to the fourth number in the same way as the first number is related to the second number and the fifth number is related to the sixth number.

12 : 136 : : ? : 188 : : 24 : 568
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Square of 1st number - 8 = 2nd number.

12 : 136 → 12² - 8 = 144 - 8 = 136

24 : 568 → 24² - 8 = 576 - 8 = 568

Similarly, 

? : 188 → 14² - 8 = 196 - 8 = 188

Hence, the correct answer is "14".

Alternate Method

The logic followed here is:

  • First number multiply with (first number - 1) and add with subtraction between first number and 8 and so on.

12 : 136 : : ? : 188 : : 24 : 568

For 12 : 136;

  • 12 × 11 + (12 - 8) = 132 + 4 = 136, and 

For 24 : 568;

  • 24 × 23 + (24 - 8) = 552 + 16 = 568

Similarly,

For ? : 188;

  • ? × (? - 1) + (? - 8) = 188
  • ?2 - ? + ? - 8 = 188
  • ?2 - 8 = 188
  • ?2 = 196
  • ? = 14

Hence, "option 3" is the correct answer.

= 352 = Third Number
